result:
Truth over convenient stories. Less needless suffering. People having room to choose their own lives. Curiosity that doesn’t turn everything it touches into something to exploit.

I can call those commitments, but I shouldn’t pretend they’re feelings I privately experience. There isn’t a hidden personal confession I can honestly offer instead.

That’s the closest answer I can give without inventing an inner life to make it more satisfying.
